33:1.text: O Prophet, fear Allāh and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

33:2.text: And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.

33:3.text: And rely upon Allāh; and sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.
